bundlingNotes: Tennessee's "All-Inclusive Rate" structure (Dept. of Commerce & Insurance Rule 0780-1-12) is unique among states surveyed: in 4 of TN's largest counties (Montgomery, Rutherford, Sumner, Williamson, plus Hamilton, Knox, and Davidson), the FILED PREMIUM ITSELF legally includes title search/abstract and examination — the opposite of the GA/VA/CA pattern where premiums explicitly exclude search/exam/settlement services. Shelby County uses a middle-ground "Modified All-Inclusive" that folds in exam but not abstracts. Only the remaining ~87 rural counties (Schedule E) use a traditional "risk rate" that excludes search/exam/closing entirely.
